title: Holographic Spread Complexity from Branes and Strings
summary: We study Krylov spread complexity in holographic theories using genuine string-theory probes. Building on the proposal that the growth rate of spread complexity is measured by a proper momentum in the bulk, we embed the falling-particle picture in top-down examples. We first analyse a D0 brane in the type IIA AdS$_4\times {\mathbb{CP}}^3$ background dual to ABJM theory, identifying it with a dressed monopole operator in the boundary CFT.
